mapper.select: SELECT b.bill_no AS billNo, b.order_no AS orderNo, standard_order.order_no AS standardOrderNo, b.customer_name AS customerName, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(b.bill_amount, 2)) AS billAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(b.paid_amount, 2)) AS paidAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(GREATEST(b.bill_amount - b.paid_amount, 0), 2)) AS unpaidAmount, b.bill_status AS billStatus, b.bill_status_type AS billStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(b.due_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS dueAt, DATE_FORMAT(b.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt, latest_prepay.prepay_order_no AS latestPrepayOrderNo, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(latest_prepay.amount, 2)) AS latestPrepayAmount, latest_prepay.pay_scene AS latestPayScene, latest_prepay.cashier_status AS latestCashierStatus, latest_prepay.cashier_status_type AS latestCashierStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(latest_prepay.expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS latestPrepayExpiresAt, latest_payment.payment_order_id AS latestPaymentOrderId, latest_payment_prepay.prepay_order_no AS latestPaymentPrepayOrderNo, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(latest_payment.amount, 2)) AS latestPaymentAmount, latest_payment.payment_method AS latestPaymentMethod, latest_payment.channel_code AS latestPaymentChannel, latest_payment.status AS latestPaymentStatus, latest_payment.status_type AS latestPaymentStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(latest_payment.success_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS latestPaymentSuccessAt FROM t_bill b LEFT JOIN t_order standard_order ON standard_order.order_no = b.order_no LEFT JOIN t_prepay_order latest_prepay ON latest_prepay.id = ( SELECT latest_pr.id FROM t_prepay_order latest_pr WHERE latest_pr.bill_no = b.bill_no ORDER BY latest_pr.created_at DESC, latest_pr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN t_payment_order latest_payment ON latest_payment.id = ( SELECT latest_po.id FROM t_prepay_order payment_pr INNER JOIN t_payment_order latest_po ON latest_po.payment_order_id = payment_pr.payment_order_id WHERE payment_pr.bill_no = b.bill_no ORDER BY latest_po.created_at DESC, latest_po.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) LEFT JOIN t_prepay_order latest_payment_prepay ON latest_payment_prepay.id = ( SELECT payment_link_pr.id FROM t_prepay_order payment_link_pr WHERE payment_link_pr.payment_order_id = latest_payment.payment_order_id AND payment_link_pr.bill_no = b.bill_no ORDER BY payment_link_pr.created_at DESC, payment_link_pr.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE b.bill_no = #{billNo} LIMIT 1

if.test: query.billStatus != null and query.billStatus != '' and query.billStatus != '全部'

SELECT bill_no AS billNo, order_no AS orderNo, customer_name AS customerName, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(bill_amount, 2)) AS billAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(paid_amount, 2)) AS paidAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(bill_amount - paid_amount, 2)) AS unpaidAmount, bill_status AS billStatus, bill_status_type AS billStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(due_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS dueAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_bill
LIMIT #{query.limit} OFFSET #{query.offset}

SELECT COUNT(1) AS totalBillCount, SUM(CASE WHEN bill_status IN ('已支付', '已结清') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS paidBillCount, SUM(CASE WHEN bill_status = '待支付' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpaidBillCount, SUM(CASE WHEN bill_status = '部分支付' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partialPaidBillCount, SUM(CASE WHEN due_at < NOW() AND bill_status NOT IN ('已支付', '已结清') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdueBillCount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(SUM(bill_amount), 0), 2)) AS totalBillAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0), 2)) AS totalPaidAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(COALESCE(SUM(bill_amount - paid_amount), 0), 2)) AS totalUnpaidAmount FROM t_bill

SELECT bill_no AS billNo, order_no AS orderNo, customer_name AS customerName, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(bill_amount, 2)) AS billAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(paid_amount, 2)) AS paidAmount, CONCAT('¥', FORMAT(bill_amount - paid_amount, 2)) AS unpaidAmount, bill_status AS billStatus, bill_status_type AS billStatusType, DATE_FORMAT(due_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS dueAt, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createdAt FROM t_bill
LIMIT 1001
